scenarios.name: Commit a separator as the only custom panel item

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible
the Part Tools custom panel list is empty
the user opens ribbon customization with All Commands selected
the user double-clicks "<Separator>" in the available list
the custom panel list contains one separator
no User Commands panel is visible on the Tools ribbon
the Part Tools custom panel list contains one separator
the user double-clicks the separator in the custom panel list
no User Commands panel is visible on the Tools ribbon
